RPG MO is a nostalgic indie MMORPG where you can train 19 different skills.

We are a small team of 2 developers who have been working on the game as a hobby for the last 12 years.

Play on desktop https://data.mo.ee/loader.html

Download RPG MO for iOS https://apps.apple.com/app/rpg-mo/id601177570

Download RPG MO for Android https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=ee.mo.rpg

Patch news https://forums.mo.ee/viewtopic.php?t=11824

Join our Discord https://mo.ee/discord

Anniversary event will last until 31st of July.
